notes.title: New Intensive Character Update; Carolina
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/bc529a2b1a92895a6eb3e4c470754d14da45b7be.png[/img]

Meet Intensive Carolina and with his new outfit! It’s time to workout!
Intensive Carolina can choose intensive skill to enhance her defensive, shooting, or ball recovery abilities!
Check out her Intensive skill now!

[Manual Block]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/214057eb872752424b22456324c9b229a26d8ede.png[/img]

[Quick Jumper]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/6650da2b8d9548a2c44bb18205be13e6adce13b4.png[/img]

[Diving Catch]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/66f33708db7360ade92b82e89cd983ef1b39b9f9.png[/img]

2. Outfit Purchase-All Function Update
No more stress to buying each outfit!
Wear and customize your best fit and purchase it at once!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/991591dcbe1146414b89a13bd0b9aa46fca8dadb.png[/img]

1) You can try outfit on each part from the shop. To try on, select the outfit then select [Try On]
2) If you want to try different costume set, you can remove that at once
3) If you like your current outfit, you can purchase all outfits at once
*Please note that purchased outfit belongs to your currently selected character.
Don’t forget to enjoy discount event for all outfits for a limited time!
It’s time to dress up for your own style!

3. Minor Change Notice
1) Outfit resell price change
-If you own outfit that in the draw list such as shopping bag, the resell value may change
2) Training Quest reward change
-Training Quest now give you items instead of EXP
-If you are under progressing Training Quest, your current progress is reset to new one and you have to finish from the beginning

*If you already finished, your progress will not be affected.

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: 2025 Official Dec Tournament Pre-Notice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/cc1b29d80ad18a24ba7c1cf1456b4f706a06f621.jpg[/img]

An official global tournament for 3on3 Players will be held on December 2025!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/db70922c22cc0e41fb0f3e8b6f9b4d073edf7ab8.jpg[/img]

Please be ready for the grand fight at the end of year!

If you want to participate the 2025 tourney, please read carefully below.

1) How To Be Qualified for Tourney
- Starts from this Ranked Mode, your Autumn Season Rank Score will determine your qualification for tourney
- We will list up total Autumn Season Rank Score of each party and top 8 teams (include those who won last tournament) will be qualified for 2025 Dec Tournament
[list]
[*] Your Season Rank Score will be determined based on your Rank results of Autumn Season
- How to enroll your entry will be announced later when official tournament notice is released
[*] If you a winner of previous tournament, we will contact you via e-mail after official notice
[*] If you own the seed ticket, you can participate the tourney regardless of your members’ season rank score. But you have to enroll your entry.
[/list]

2) Tournament Information
- Top 8 teams will be qualified for tournament for each region
[list]
[*] This includes winner of previous tournament. If winner failed to respond within deadline, you will lose your qualification
[/list]
- Entry enrollment is scheduled to be opened during October (can be changed)
- Tournament is planned to be held in the late December
- Detailed information regarding 2025 Dec Tournament will be announced later
- All details and rules are subject to be changed without notice

Be ready for the fight if you are interested in the tourney!
Start cumulating your Season Rank Score for our grand fight!

[i][b][color=darkorange]- 3ON3 FREESTYLE TEAM[/color][/b][/i]

[color=cyan][b]New Character Update; Siana[/b][/color]

[previewyoutube=uoKj543s_5Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Meet Siana, Re:Union’s Big Sister!

Siana has special ability to change her form during the game!

Experience Siana’s unexpected strength now!

[h3][b][Post Up Dunk][/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/2b5f9d228ef9711b7525e9dc0a04cba9532d3333.png[/img]
Can attempt Dunk while performing Post Up Turn. 

[h3][b][Model Change!][/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/13f07081baf2a0aa5a969f4218680a7627decf81.png[/img]
Siana has a workout gauge and can gain energy while moving. She gains energy more when using dash. When the workout gauge is full, she performs a Model Change, temporarily transforming into a different appearance. When transformed, Siana recovers from the stamina debuff. In Model status, she consumes 40% of her Balance stat and increases Running and Long-Distance Dunk stats by 35% of her Balance stat. 

[h3][b][Super Model][/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/de0ed504ac68a98be24ea2c442896376a3da9ab0.png[/img]
Get special buff effect on specific skills based on her status.

General Status : Can push the opponent by chance when landing with a Power Rebound or attempting a Dunk. The chance is based on the difference between Balance stats.

Model Change Status : Can perform quicker jump for Power Rebound. Siana can avoid the frontal Block attempt within designated area by chance when performing Long-Distance dunk. 

[h2][b][color=darkorange][Intensive Skill][/color][/b][/h2]

Siana comes out as Intensive Prestige unlocked! Check out her 3 strong intensive skills!

Greetings FS City,

The following are the updates for the end of this month.

[h2][b][color=orange]1. P-Buff System Renewal[/color][/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/cb7a2e3f9ffc16049b3cd53f7a06da9f85348d03.png[/img]

Boost your character with P-Buff addition for Intensive Prestige!

Check out how it works!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/1799c38948d061f7ce617e7ee08b9b1dd5948ad1.png[/img]

[color=cyan]>[/color] Now you can confirm P-Buff change result
[list]
[*]If you do not like the result, you can cancel the change or reroll to get different P-Buff result
[/list]
[color=cyan]>[/color] Intensive Character can unlock Sub P-Buff slot (1 for each Intensive Prestige, 2 total)
[color=cyan]>[/color] Sub P-Buff is same for all character. For detailed list, please refer draw rate [Sub P-Buff Rate]
[color=cyan]>[/color] You cannot set same Sub P-Buff for each slot. Each character can set unique Sub P-Buff for each slot
[color=cyan]>[/color] Sub P-Buff works same as current P-Buff system, giving buff effect for position

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/2c863eb07c8d1b9d9e53a2b966e7a7530d321996.png[/img]

[color=cyan]>[/color] If you unlock Intensive Prestige, Sub P-Buff slot will be unlocked (1 for each Intensive Prestige, 2 total)
[list]
[*] For example, if your character is P7, you can use 2 P-Buff slot for Position Buff slot 1 & 2. That will be 4 Sub P-Buffs
[/list]
[color=cyan]>[/color] All characters have same Sub P-Buff list. Please check Sub P-Buff rate for more detail. [Sub P-Buff List]
[list]
[*] Sub P-Buff list for P-Buff Slot 1 & 2 is different
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d4e75396ec180816f1cb8f2592e73d903f3d2794.png[/img]

[color=cyan]>[/color] No duplicate Sub P-Buff will appear. For example, if you get A Sub P-Buff effect for Sub P-Buff 1, same buff will not appear for Sub P-Buff 2
[color=cyan]>[/color] Sub P-Buff works same as current P-Buff system. Giving buff effect for position
[color=cyan]>[/color] When you change P-Buff, Main and Sub P-Buff will change altogether. You cannot change it separately
[color=cyan]>[/color] If you are setting FIRST Sub P-Buff for your current P6 or P7 character, you will not consume P-Buff Ticket. Your current main P-Buff will not change also for first setting, instead Sub P-Buff will be added for your P-Buff slot. After first setting, all P-Buff will change if you try to change the P-Buff

notes.title: Patch Note ver. 1.1.157 (June 11)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/9d9a79c5d21594aaf6a539f49179e8ac160834ab.jpg[/img]

Greetings FS City,

The following are the updates for this month.

[h2][b][color=darkorange][System][/color][/b][/h2]

[color=cyan][b]1. New Character Update; Marisol[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c84b3c7ab6f3ed5c497d357308cc88291eb269ff.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=2cUwzikkUqY;full][/previewyoutube]

Meet Marisol, Nathan’s most trusted friend!

Experience Marisol’s powerful abilities as Re:Union!

[h3][b][Shot Fake Dash][/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d22548785b03736b6ef4040ea2e8b7a4e2ccbd5d.png[/img]
After a Shot Fake, breakthrough the opponent like passing by. Fake the opponent and quickly dash to the safe spot for best chance!

[h3][b][Blind Face-Up][/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/60a6bf605f3c76fa6bdf5c76ee9dd3fc7fbada42.png[/img]
Perform a pressing Face-Up motion and reduce the opponent's shot success rate. When the opponent is pressed by Face-Up, the opponent's ball can be stolen by chance when attempting fake and shot. No one can shoot in front of Marisol’s hard guard!

[h3][b][Look At Me!]][/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/eee1150b098f1a2d59f26af54a01c1f0b63433de.png[/img]
3-Point Shot success rate increases when shooting from left or right side areas. When Marisol received a pass from Nathan, 3-Point Shot success rate increases 4% additionally. Look at her! Marisol needs your attention! Pass to her for score chance! 

[h3][b][Leave It To Me!][/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3b84ba1f0fb110c7c69a2a3b71dc638919d3b62f.png[/img]
Instantly dashes to the desired direction to quickly move to the position in need. Gauge automatically charges during the game. When losing, gauge charges faster. Marisol is ready to run! Just call her and she will be right there for you!

[h2][b][color=darkorange][Intensive Skill][/color][/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/5a030e251a889ad5c0346cfff58956b5a4757506.png[/img]

Marisol comes out as Intensive Prestige unlocked! Check out her 3 strong intensive skills!

[h3][b][Box Out Swim Move][/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/157245b2fa2d4f5b74e83879ed4231d3806eb756.png[/img]

[h3][b][Shooting Touch][/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/30071a45ff6927721998c40480095c831691c2bd.png[/img]

[h3][b][Diving Catch]][/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0807254c40acdedc00fb80ee1261751e0530f12d.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[color=cyan][b]2. Ability Card System Renewal[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/7674db5d567fc8c891c188b10dc8224f001565a9.png[/img]

Upgrade your character’s ability with the Growth Box!

Meet ability cards with upgraded deals!

[b][color=darkorange][Ability Card Box System][/color][/b]
- Previous Ability Card pack systems are now changed to Ability Card Box system
[list]
[*] Silver Card Pack -> Coin Box
[*] Gold/Platinum Card Pack -> Growth Box
[/list]
-You can purchase 2 different boxes : 
[list]
[*] Coin Box : Ability Card Box can purchase with Coins
[*] Growth Box : Ability Card Box can purchase with Points
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/eb5ba262a3dd09f6d82246831de4a6d63dace424.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/b14ac379ade60db303c442901455bea970a1ab16.png[/img]

- Starting from Gold grade, you can level up Growth Box’s level for better odds
- You can only upgrade Growth Box by purchasing with points. Purchasing with tickets will not increase Box EXP
- If your Growth Box’s level increased in the middle of pulling, enhanced rate will be applied upon level up
[list]
[*] Ex : If you pull 10 cards and Growth Box levels up in 5th result, you will get enhanced rate for 6th~10th results
[/list]
- Growth Box level applies to each character and will not be shared
- Coin Box will not upgrade upon purchase
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/6f2a8119455e279213092104f3b3dc694ca720e1.jpg[/img]
- You cannot use previous silver & gold card ticket to purchase new Ability Box. Instead, you can exchange them from Special Shop
- Any remaining Random/Selectable card packs can be used after this update. 

[b][color=darkorange][Ability Card Change][/color][/b]
- Now Ability Card does not share stat range. Minimum stat of Platinum Card is higher than Maximum stat of Gold Card
- Upon stat range change we have fixed following cards to apply current Ability Card stat rule
[list]
[*] If your Platinum Card’s stat value is lower than current criteria, your card’s stat is enhanced to meet minimum stat of Platinum card
[*] If your card have stat value of higher grade but current grade is lower, your card’s grade is changed to meet stat value
[*] If your Pizza Card’s one of stat value is below card’s grade, lower stat is enhanced to meet minimum stat of current card’s grade
- Slot types of cards with different card slots have been unified
[*] If your owned card’s slot type is different from current system, your card slot type is changed to be unified
[*] If your card’s slot type is changed, we will compensate your character’s box ticket for each card
[list]
[*] Silver Card : Character’s Coin Box Ticket x1
[*] Gold Card : Character’s Growth Box Ticket x1
[*] Platinum Card : Character’s Growth Box Ticket x2
[*] Reward Date : 6/18 maintenance
[/list]
- New ability stats are added! Customize your character for more strategical way!
[list]
[*] Dribble Steal Resist
[*] Intercept Resist
[*] Reduce Shot Success Rate Decrease after Fake
[*] Shot Impediment Invalidity
[*] Mid-Range Shot Impediment Invalidity
[*] 3-Point-Shot Impediment Invalidity
[/list]
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[color=cyan][b]3. In-Game System Change[/b][/color]

3on3 FreeStyle always encourage you to follow sportsmanship in any time.

For better game experience, we have adjusted following in-game system

Please check below for details

[b][2025 Summer League][/b]
- Now you can redeem your league reward from League Event page during reward date
- We will have 1 week of review period to check league record
- If we find any abusive behavior, your league reward may be disregarded
- If your Fair Play Score is below 30, your League Score will not be recorded
[b][Fair Play System][/b]
- You cannot invite users whose Fair Play Score is below 30
- If your Fair Play Score is too low, you cannot send or accept an invitation

[color=yellow][i][b]- 3on3 Freestyle Team[/b][/i][/color]

notes.title: 7th Dev Note
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/de7353bcf1ce6d824f85d410c1cdba57e1b1cb30.jpg[/img]

Hello! We are <3on3 FreeStyle] developer team.

We would like to show our greetings to our dear <3on3 FreeStyle> ballers.

We would like to inform you of the 7th Dev Note regarding the upcoming June updates.

[h3][color=orange][b]<Ability Card System Renewal>[/b][/color][/h3]

In 3on3 FreeStyle, Ability Cards are one of the most important features for gameplay. To help our ballers obtain better cards more easily, we plan to renew the Ability Card system to make it more convenient and user-friendly.

This update is scheduled for June, though please note that some details may change when the update is officially released.
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/955c42eb694b32049724b1f45ace066207bbd3e1.png[/img][/td]
[td]
[list]
[*][b] Current Card System Removal[/b]
[/list]
[olist]
[*] Silver / Gold / Platinum packs will no longer be available
[*] Any remaining Random/Selectable card packs in your mailbox can be used even after the renewal update
[*] Any remaining Silver & Gold card tickets can be consumed in the special shop
[/olist]
[list]
[*][b] Pre-Notice Of New Card System[/b]
[/list]
[olist]
[*] Silver Card Pack will be changed to (new) Coin Card Box
[*] Gold / Platinum Card Pack will be changed to a single (new) Point Card Box
[*] Upon purchase, you can upgrade Point Card Box's level. The higher the level, the better the odds you get for the higher card grade.
[*] At the Max card box level, you can get higher odds for the Platinum Card compared to the current Platinum Card Pack rate. Detailed draw rate will be announced later when the official update is released.
[*] Card Box level is applied to each character
[/olist]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[hr][/hr]

[h3][color=orange][b]<In-Game Balance Patch>[/b][/color][/h3]
In this balance patch, we are planning to adjust several characters' skills to encourage various skill tactics.

This update is scheduled for May, though please note that some details may change when the update is officially released.
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td]
[list]
[*][b] "Screen Body Check" will become the default skill[/b]
	1. All characters can use "Screen Body Check" skill
		- Characters who already own this skill will get an extra stat for Screen Body 
[*][b] Alley-Oop Balance Change[/b]
	1. Opponent cannot block from behind the user who receives the Alley-Oop pass and tries to Dunk
[*][b] Balance Stat Balance Change[/b]
	1. During Screen collision, the speed of recovery from the collision will be based on the difference between Balance stats
		If the screener's Balance stat is higher than yours, your recovery speed becomes lower
	2. Post Up Speed and Turn Speed become faster based on your Balance stats
[*][b] Floater Balance Change[/b]
	1. Floater Shot speed increase
	2. Floater Shot will have a higher arc
[*][b] Lulu Balance Change[/b]
	1. Poised To Learn Adjustment
		Rebound stat increases after losing a rebound to the opponent
			Rebound +15 (Max 4 times)
[/list]
[/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/200a3a40801ee835318f30db36c2d043b1e1520b.png[/img]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

We will continuously review the skills and characters that are less preferred and encourage the gameplay environment where you can use various skills, freestyles, and tactics.

You can find out detailed information from [b][Character[/b]] > [b][Balance Patch][/b]

We would like to close our 7th Dev Note now.

We hope our dear ballers can continue to enjoy <3on3 FreeStyle> and keep your passion for basketball.

Thank you! 
 
[b][I][color=yellow]- 3on3 FreeStyle Developer Team[/color][/i][/b]

notes.title: 6th Dev Note
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/76473f4df3599fb1b0a88b8a8607972c51aa83f5.jpg[/img]

Hello! We are <3on3 FreeStyle] developer team.
 

We would like to show our greetings to our dear <3on3 FreeStyle> ballerrs.

We would like to inform you of the 6th Dev Note regarding the upcoming 4/16 updates.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/e9a2f91ac761545613df082661a8146fa22119a9.png[/img][/td]
[td]
[h3][color=orange][b]<Nathan, Re:Union, and his First Friend>[/b][/color][/h3]

Our new legend, Nathan, is seeking his old friend to form his old crew, "Re:Union."
[list]
[*]Nathan in Stories
[list]
[*]Nathan, who hails from an orphanage, once teamed up with friends to sweep many competitions. However, they gave up basketball for practical reasons and split up. In contrast to his friends, Nathan decided on his own career paths and continued to challenge himself.
[*]Nathan, who continued to play basketball, never achieved his dream of becoming a professional player. Instead of being frustrated, Nathan chose a new challenge. Nathan founded a crew called Re: Union and is on his way to find his friends.
[/list]
[*]His First Friend "Mari"
[list]
[*]You may find a mysterious character, "Mari," in Nathan's Full trailer. "Mari" is Nathan's close friend who always comes forward and helps Nathan when he and his friends get in trouble. "Mari" is the first member to come up in Nathan's mind when he decided to form "Re:Union".
[/list][/list]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][color=orange][b]<4/16 Balance Patch>[/b][/color][/h3]

In this balance patch, we are planning to adjust Clara's "Dash Steal" and less preferred characters. Also, we are considering changing the gameplay environment, such as time-dragging behavior or screen playing.

To enhance tension until the last minute, it will be harder to keep the ball oneself, and you need more sophisticated tactics to use the screen. Based on screen location or angle, the teammate's shooting will be highly affected. The teamwork of the screener and the shooter becomes more important, and we encourage you to keep that in consideration when you do screenplays.

[list]
[*][b]Character Balance Patch[/b]
[b]1. Clara[/b]
[list]
[*]"Dash Steam" Steal Max Distance 325cm -> 275cm
[*]7 sec Cooldown Added To "Dash Steal"
[/list]
[b]2. Helena[/b]
[list]
[*]Smile In Love : All Stats of Male Character Increase by 7
[*]Hustle Pass : Max Pass Distance and Pass Speed Increase
[/list]
[b]3. Ginger[/b]
[list]
[*]Unbelievable : Max Pass Distance and Pass Speed Increase
[/list]
[b]4. Amanda[/b]
[list]
[*]Dancer's Finesse :
[list]
[*]Shoot Success Rate +7%
[*]Shoot Speed Increases by 30%
[/list][/list]
[b]5. Clarke[/b]
[list]
[*]Resilient Fighter : Activated by 20% Chance When Clarke's Dunk is Blocked
[*]Long Distance Dunk : 165 -> 185 (P5 Lv.Max)

[*][b]Steal Balance Patch[/b]
[olist]
[*]If you hold the ball for 2 sec or more in the Corner, the Probability of Getting Stolen and the Stealable Angle will increase significantly, which makes the opponent to steal the ball easier.
[*]In the last 20 seconds of each round, Stealable Chance, Distance, and Angle will be increased in the far area from the 3-point line.  As the end of time approaches, if you take the ball in a far position, it makes the opponent to steal the ball easier.
[/olist]

[*][b]Screen Shoot[/b]
[olist]
[*]If the teammate's screen stands on the right in front of the shooter, the Shot Success Rate decreases significantly. 
[*]If the shooter stands right in front of the teammate's screen, the Shot Success Rate decreases significantly.
[/olist]

[*][b]Pass[/b]
[olist]
[*]All characters' Pass Distance increase
[*]Now you can try to pass from a farther distance without making the Long Pass
[/olist]
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/65dc4cb22a4ac9072b5c90c05f8e6284d5c94908.png[/img][/td]
[td]

[h3][color=orange][b]<UI/UX Improvement>[/b][/color][/h3]

We have improved several menus that you use repeatedly so that you can use them more conveniently.

[list]
[*][b]UI/UX Improvement[/b]
[list]
[*]You can upgrade character's level and prestige in the same menu
[*]You can upgrade character's level at once
[*]You can purchase insufficient Intensive Manual straight away from the Prestige Up menu
[*]You can purchase P-Buff ticket straight away from the Position Buff menu
[/list][/list]

We are planning more UI/UX improvements in the future.

We promise to provide more convenient game experience.
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[/list]

We would like to close our 6th Dev Note now.

We hope our dear ballers can continue to enjoy <3on3 FreeStyle> and keep your passion for basketball.

Thank you! 

 
[b][I][color=yellow]- 3on3 FreeStyle Developer Team[/color][/i][/b]

notes.title: Fan Box Guaranteed Count Issue
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/cc669fcf5c2b63a97c4bb7f77817c4b18e8264e8.jpg[/img]

Dear Ballers,

We have identified the following issue with the Best Seller Fan Box event:
The Guaranteed P5 Character count is not accumulating for some users.

Our development team is actively working on a fix, and we will provide a separate notice once we are ready to perform maintenance and apply the patch.

Fix Details:

1. Affected Users:
Users whose Guaranteed P5 Character count did not accumulate.
Users who have not pulled a P5 Character from the Fan Box event.

2. Fix Implementation:
Your previous pull count will be properly applied to the Guaranteed Count system.
If you have pulled 125 times or more, you will receive your selected P5 Character.

Please note that if you have already obtained a P5 Character from the event, the Guaranteed Pity System will be locked automatically. In such cases, we will not adjust your Guaranteed Count, as the system is already closed.

We are working to resolve this issue as soon as possible and sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.​

- 3on3 Freestyle Team

notes.title: Known Issue After 3/19 Maintenance Fix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/35e1a6e55792e7700350ccb18185c383a01b8c31.png[/img]

Dear ballers,
We have fixed the issues that occurred after the update and sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. 
Please check below for the details.
 
[PS - Stat Boost Event Issue]
The following issues occurred due to an error in the PS Stat Boost event:
- Missions are automatically completed without any progress.
- Unlocked rewards could not be claimed
 
To fix this, we made the following changes:
- All Stat Boost mission progress has been reset, regardless of the previous progress before maintenance
- Players who completed the Stat Boost missions properly before maintenance will keep their progress
 
During the reset process, all missions except for the "Upgrade Nathan's Prestige Mission" have been reset, so players need to complete them again.
We sincerely apologize and ask for your understanding.
For Nathan-related missions, progress will automatically update based on Nathan’s current level when logging in.
 
[Steam - Point Bundle DLC Issue]
The prices of Ultimate Point Bundle DLC ($79.99) and Premium Point Bundle DLC ($29.99) were incorrectly set. To resolve this, we took the following actions:
 
1) Players who purchased the Ultimate Point Bundle for $29.99
- Requested a refund through Steam.
- Retrieved the incorrectly purchased DLC.
 
2) Players who purchased the Premium Point Bundle for $79.99
- Provided additional items to match the Ultimate Point Bundle
- Adjusted the 'Cumulative Payment Event' score to reflect the correct DLC price
 
To allow players to purchase the corrected DLC normally, we reset the purchase limit.
Since Steam handles refunds, the process may take some time. We appreciate your patience and understanding.
 
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and will work to prevent similar issues in the future.
 
Thank you.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/e82410596928bcb535b63ae069928ba6e27627d2.jpg[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The following are the updates for the end of this month.

[color=darkorange][b][System][/b][/color]

[color=orange][b]1. New Character Update; Nathan[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/bfe6211237c64c4fe632633e3383f0d8900c86c7.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=9trGE5Ys6bQ?;full][Insert Spotlight Video] -[/previewyoutube]

Meet Nathan and help him to gather his old members to rebirth Re:Union!

Experience Nathan’s hidden strength when his team is in clutch situation!

[color=skyblue][b][Swing Dribble][/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/103bbd1a22e72c09fe8cc467c9ad50faafc31afc.png[/img]

Normal breakthrough motion is changed to exclusive Swing Dribble motion with wider left-right swing motion. Press the breakthrough button to move backward quickly. Swing left or right to break through the opponent and move backward to create open space!

[color=skyblue][b][Back Dribble Fade Away][/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/509923dbf46cc08efe3c76fa5a98572960c3ad90.png[/img]

Can perform Fade Away after Back Dribble. Can perform quick Side Step after Back Dribble by pressing left or right button. Make your space with Back Dribble and aim for scoring chance with Fade Away! Utilize quick Side Step to deceive the opponent’s guard!

[color=skyblue][b][Clutch Maker][/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a9d01123af4a13e26e2300c0f02d1145a53695e3.png[/img]

When Nathan attempts a long-distance dunk, Nathan will evade the opponent's block attempt by 50% chance and shoot. .Avoid opponent’s block attempt and secure your score chance with clutch move!

[color=skyblue][b][Hot Hand][/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/11ced5f39367ad8c7751133294b08aded15c88f6.png[/img]

Nathan becomes significantly stronger in clutch situation. (Clutch Situation : 30 seconds left / 3 Points Differences) When Hot Hand activated, Nathan’s long-distance dunk always avoids blocks, and all jump shot gets less defense resist. Trust our leader Nathan in clutch situation. He will bring the victory!

[hr][/hr]
[color=darkorange][b][Intensive Skill][/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c03b253f4fc2d8999152c7f4c0b0cf2b9b472063.png[/img]

Nathan comes out as Intensive Prestige unlocked! Check out his 3 strong intensive skills!

[color=skyblue][b][Box Out][/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/f3663185cfbe5e772880d57ca6c0bf4b7134ed19.png[/img]

[color=skyblue][b][Quick Jumper][/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/d8ea42d5f924e7253b60daef2cf7777d3926bc08.png[/img]

[color=skyblue][b][Diving Catch][/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0807254c40acdedc00fb80ee1261751e0530f12d.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[color=darkorange][b]2. New Rank Mode Update; Ultimate Rank Mode[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ca81f2bc7789deb377c0b28c20d84896359d20f9.png[/img]

Brand new rank mode with hyper ultimate skills!

Use ultimate skills to rule out the court! Let’s check out key point of this mode!
- No P-Buff, FreeStyle, Ability Card, and Pet Skill apply to this mode
- Game Rule : 3 min, single round game
- When game starts, 1 out of 9 ultimate skills is randomly selected
- To use ultimate skill, you need energy. Energy is charged automatically as game time passes by
- After using current ultimate skill, next skill is randomly selected, and you can recharge the energy
- You can only own 1 ultimate skill at the same time
- If the score difference is more than 5 points, winning team’s energy charge speed will be decreased

Check out some Ultimate skills you can use this mode!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/e1e73a0b0930db4494e5c4d5e2a3701f776d35c9.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/e33e99b74499a92110fdb8cb9b8f8c4e1a91f9e6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/adb0a87c43ff605c340649e6735970eb8b03c142.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/2d8c40f1a7db2a2f54e2537b62977f5f886bd02f.gif[/img]

[quote][color=red]*[/color]Video is a demo. Actual skill animation is subject to change.[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/24b33381327dfed66ba8431986b5f9a20037ebae.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/32c3ee9fedd0b288a1f841f1567800f72a5db366.png[/img]
You can find out more in the Ultimate Rank line-up page!

[hr][/hr]
[color=darkorange][b]3. Battle Pass Renewal Pre-Notice[/b][/color]

From this spring, Battle Pass comes out with a renewed deal!

Please check below what the planned change!

1) Change applied since this Battle pass
- Battle Pass period is shortened from 8 weeks to 4 weeks
- Battle Pass part is not increased from 2 to 3
- Battle Pass ticket price is decreased from 149 to 119 points

2) Change will be applied (subject to change)
- You can purchase the previous Battle Pass to unlock the event even after the event period is over

[color=yellow][i][b]- 3on3 Freestyle Team[/b][/i][/color]

notes.title: [Notice] SSL Certificate Update for Steam Users
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/5cba381b12fe101a2e191e4cb754237120d006a1.jpg[/img]

Dear ballers,
 
On February 5th, the SSL certificate for Steam users will be updated.
As a result, some users may see a certificate installation pop-up when logging in.
To ensure smooth gameplay, please follow the instructions in the pop-up and install the certificate as guided.
 
※ This update applies only to Steam users and does not affect console users (PlayStation/Xbox) or other platforms.

-----
 
▶ Why is the certificate update necessary?
The SSL certificate is being updated in accordance with GlobalSign’s policy.
To ensure smooth access to the game, this update is mandatory. If a login issue occurs, a certificate installation pop-up will be displayed.

Please follow the instructions in the pop-up and complete the installation process.
 
For more details, please visit the GlobalSign official website:
[url=https://support.globalsign.com/ca-certificates/intermediate-certificates]https://support.globalsign.com/ca-certificates/intermediate-certificates[/url]
 
▶ I failed to update the certificate!
If you still cannot access the game after installing the certificate, the update may have failed.
For a quick resolution, please contact our customer support.
 
*Customer Support:
[url=https://joycity.oqupie.com/portals/395/inquiry]https://joycity.oqupie.com/portals/395/inquiry[/url]
 
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

Thank you!

[i][b]~ 3on3 Freestyle Team[/b][/i]

We have fixed issue where some users get Intensive SF Manual duplicately from the event.

All possible Intensive SG Manuals are retrieved during the emergency maintenance.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Patch Note: New Character Update; Yuna
notes.content:
​[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/4954ef7cf61b207d06192570cde87d47b6f05ada.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for the end of this month.

[b][color=orange]1. New Character Update; Yuna[/color][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ff0a75cddf285c08329e355d698720c0f85d8574.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=v6LAfawcuJo;full][Insert Spotlight Video] -[/previewyoutube]

Meet Yuna, the shy yet unstoppable new star to find her only friend in Fox Court!

Join her on Fox Court to discover the ultimate joy of basketball!

[color=gold][Spin Double Clutch Layup][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ced0964a6461a95b973c2a85828b86accf4a2962.png[/img]

Can perform a layup in the air by spinning Yuna's body during a long-distance layup. Change Yuna’s move during layup to fake the block to score!

[color=gold][Fake Shot][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/75a615608ddaf56e97a1129f2d42523e6576ce20.png[/img]

Can make a shot while stepping sideways after shot fake. Fake the opponent with shot fake and quickly move to the safe position to aim the open chance!

[color=gold][Lucky Chance][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/520f136de916d2913f8f94435fae8d4c00ac43da.png[/img]

Whenever Yuna or any teammate scores, Yuna gets a lucky chance to get a special buff.

(If Yuna gets a different buff, all buff effects will be applied. No duplicate buff will be applied)

1. Long-distance layup increase
2. Normal moving speed increase
3. 3-point-shot attribute increase

Make Yuna stronger whenever Home scores!

[color=gold][Collector][/color]

notes.title: [UPDATE] Patch Note: Rank Season Stat Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0897225ba80e956dbc39326c30611a631457b578.jpg[/img]

Greetings, FS City

The followings are the updates for this month.

[color=orange][b]1. Rank Season Stat Update[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/079bb0af4dcbe542dd036667cede52867f089b9d.png[/img]

Check out your Rank Season result directly!
All of your Rank Season result will be recorded here!
Be the highest Ranker of All Season!
Let’s check out how system works!

[color=orange][b][What Is Rank Season Stat?][/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/7e757c502c779206d2e8a42629fd7a92354f8157.png[/img]

1) Ranked Mode, Rank 3x3, and Astro Buff Rank’s results will be combined into Season Rank
    • Please note we will still run 3 different rank modes for each season!

2) Your Season Rank will be determined by result of 3 different rank modes for declared season

3) In the Rank Season Stat page, you can check your Season Rank and rank modes results

4) Your first participation region of season (regardless of mode) will be your current Rank Season Stat’s region. For example, if you participate in NA region for Ranked Mode then move to EU region for Rank 3x3, your Rank 3x3 record will not be recorded in Rank Season Stat.

5) Based on your Season Rank Score, you will receive special Emblem for the season

6) First Season will be 2024 winter season

[color=orange][b][How To Check Rank Season Stat?][/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/dcdef4800a31fba2544881356eebb908ab863f7a.png[/img]

1) In the lobby, YouTube icon is replaced to Rank Season Stat menu. Press L2/RT/X to enter the page

2) In the Rank Season Stat page, starting from 2024 Winter Season, you can check your current and upcoming rank results. To navigate easier, please use filter system.

3) In the Rank Season Stat page, you can check your top 5 characters’ play records for each rank mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a23d81e27c7640c3fa2ce5b771a0dc07880bdc49.png[/img]

4) In the Friend List, you can check your friend’s Rank Season Stat. If your friend’s privacy setting is private, you cannot check the record.
• Go to [Option]  • [Game Option] to set your privacy setting for Rank Season Stat

notes.title: 3on3 My Design Contest! Now Open!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/23f01cc7b7655e66ed4c7822cea1ed60af2f1002.png[/img]

[color=yellow][b]1. 3on3 My Design Contest[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/b68b9bec5de640de1e416771ca9b06e0d05f95df.png[/img]
Be the best designer of 3on3 FreeStyle!
3on3 My Design Contest is open now!
Let’s check out how to become the best designer of 3on3 FreeStyle

[color=orange][b][How To Participate][/b][/color]

[b][i]1) Basic Guideline[/i][/b]
• We accept design for three category: Outfit(Any Item), Pet & Accessory
• You can submit drawing or 3D work
• Please upload your work via Twitter or Facebook with the following information:
[list]
[*] Your Platform & In-Game Name
[*] Your Work
[*] Please include 2 event hashtags: #3on3FreeStyle & #2024MyDesign
[*] If you upload a drawing, please include at least 2 images of your work process or a video of your work process.
[*] If you have more than 4 images, please keep it as one thread
[*] You can submit multiple works, but only one submission will be selected
[*] No violation of copyright, age rating, legal rights, and company’s image
[/list][b][i]2) How To Prepare[/i][/b]
• You must provide at least one front design for Outfit, Pet, or Accessory
• You may use our basic model to draw on. Here's the link: [b][url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rHbWVIzA7xVIrWzo5TqXh3k_pTE3kQws?usp=sharing][DOWNLOAD][/url][/b]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][color=orange][b][u]Female (Basic Model)[/u][/b][/color][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/871d9d83ee312c878189472a782d3aef81b6599a.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][color=orange][b][u]Male (Basic Model)[/u][/b][/color][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/6602bf3809a2445a7c4920414696dc4e339cc55f.png[/img][hr][/hr]

• You can submit an outfit with a model or just an outfit:

[h3][color=orange][u][b]Submit with model and outfit (sample)[/b][/u][/color][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/1d6cbef7d6078cbfc8292e4c2776a914aceb8489.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][color=orange][b][u]Submit an outfit only (sample)[/u][/b][/color][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/e5468e8739fd4cb50ef6f112c62c03b218af37b2.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
• You must provide at least 2 images of your work process or video:

[h3][color=orange][b][u]Sample #1[/u][/b][/color][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/4d17d0c89be4c17355fecfb4b328f8ace0238129.png[/img]

[h3][color=orange][b][u]Sample#2[/u][/b][/color][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c4c04eea183fded171b4ae4ad5b43e09f483d819.png[/img]

• AI-generated art will not be accepted.
• [i]We advise you to draw at least 1000 x 1000 pixels for drawing. If your image is too small, you may have a disadvantage during the review process.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b][color=yellow][Event Schedule][/color][/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/73a8680eec9aedaff8f7bfbc89efedc27208a194.jpg[/img]
• Submission Period: 11/27 – 12/17 23:59 PST
• Internal Review: 12/18 – 12/23 23:59 PST
• Final 5 Entry Selection Announcement: 12/24 
• Popularity Vote: 12/24 – 12/31 23:59 PST
• Winner Announcement: 1/2 
• Reward Distribution: 1/8
• Event Process: Submission -> Internal Review -> Select 5 Works -> Popularity Vote -> Vote Count + Internal Review -> Winner Selected

[h3][b][color=yellow][Event Reward][/color][/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/6b8a53c2bc9d9b0a5af6abc215ae6bb4b654062d.jpg[/img]

• Winner: 5,000 Points + Platinum-Grade Best Designer Crown + Platinum-Grade Best Designer Nametag + Your Designed Item Once Updated
• 2nd – 3rd : 2,000 Points + Gold-Grade Best Designer Crown + Gold-Grade Best Designer Nametag
• 4th – 5th : 800 Points + Silver-Grade Best Designer Crown + Silver-Grade Best Designer Crown
• Random Draw: 100 Points (5 People)
• Please note that getting the most votes for popularity vote will not guarantee victory. Internal review of the 3on3 art team will decide the winner. 2nd – 5th reward is determined by vote count.

[color=orange][b][Q&A][/b][/color]

[i]1) Can I submit multiple works?[/i]
• Yes, you can submit multiple works but only one work will be considered. You cannot receive duplicate rewards.

[i]2) Will you select a winner for all categories? In other words, will we have 3 winners for this event?[/i]
• No, we will only select one winner regardless of category.

[i]3) If I get the most votes during the popularity vote, will I be the winner?[/i]
• No, the 3on3 art team will review the final candidates for the winner. Vote count may affect the decision but does not guarantee the selection.

[i]4) Will JOYCITY get the copyright of all submitted work?[/i]
• No, only the winner’s design. If you do not win first prize, we will not get any license for your design.

[i]5) Can I participate in 2024’s contest if I was accepted for 2023?[/i]
• Yes, your previous result does not affect for current contest. But we will not accept the same design if you are in the Top 5.

[i]6) Can I promote my work on other channels?[/i]
• Yes, but you MUST upload your work either on Twitter (X) or Facebook. 

[color=orange][b][Terms & Conditions][/b][/color]

• You must submit your work within the submission period. Any submission submitted AFTER the event period will be disregarded.

• You must provide all designated information and include event hashtags to be considered as a candidate.

• You must upload your work to a declared SNS (Twitter & Facebook). Any submission uploaded on other platforms will not be considered.

• No violation of copyright, age rating, legal rights, and company’s image.

• If any legal issue occurs regarding submission, all responsibilities are on the contributor’s side.

• Only one submission will be selected for one candidate. If we find a duplicate winner, only one work will be selected and others will be disregarded.

• Getting the most votes does not guarantee your winning of the contest. Vote count and internal review of the 3on3 art team will select the winner.

• 2nd to 5th winner will be determined based on your vote count.

• We may not select the winner or make the winner’s design if there is no appropriate design.

• Winner’s design may be renewed to match with 3on3 Freestyle’s design.

• All reward and reward distribution dates are subject to change without notice.

• Copyright of the winner’s design will be bound to JOYCITY and 3on3 FreeStyle team and all participants are aware of and agree with this condition.

• Winner’s design is expected to be produced by June 2024. This may change without notice.

• We may produce the winner’s design with renewed design or color in the future.

• We may ask you for the original file (PSD) of work. Refusing to provide such file may cause disqualification.

• Terms & Conditions may change without notice.

• Upon submission, you agree with our terms & conditions.

Wishing the best of luck to everyone participating in this contest!

[b]- 3on3 Freestyle Team[/b]

Clara’s Dash Steal Balance Patch
After investigating the baller’s opinions, we have found that ballers have difficulty understanding the appropriate distance to use Dash Steal effectively.

Dash Steal allows you to steal an opponent’s ball based on the distance.
To use it effectively, you MUST use the skill from the appropriate distance.

Thank you for your continued support! Enjoy gaming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/cb91d7651a36880123f35fb794ab40321252cfac.png[/img]

Our promised update is here! Desync Issue Improvement update is here to provide you fair competition environment. Let’s check out how it works!

 [olist]
[*] If your network is unstable, game will force you to synchronize with another user. System may hinder you from performing the next action

notes.title: Mini Game: Zombie Mode Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/2b8dc98094c60180196afc5fe764bc88eb4b6a74.jpg[/img]

The undead are back in town with Spooktacular events!
Check out both events and knock out the undead for special prizes!

[b]Event Period:[/b]
October 16th ~ October 22nd 23:59 (PDT)

[b]1. Zombie Mode Participation Event:[/b]

This is no ordinary survival game because it is not just about fighting off the undead. 

There is nowhere to hide either. Take a hint from the game, it is all about basketball in FS City! 

[b]Mechanics:​[/b]
Change the color of the ball with X button and score it then you will see the zombies with the same color get burned off. Try to survive as far as 7 waves to get more random boxes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/98d08adb3437c4bbd69224e3751dd814279135ac.png[/img]

[b]Rules:[/b]
- All players are set to play Joey in P5 on this mode.
- Players start off with 3 lives which drain one by one whenever you get a hit.
- ‘Breaking a curse’ skill kills all the active zombies on the court.
- ‘Breaking a curse’ gauge fills up whenever you lose your HP or make combos. 
- When the gauge is full, you can activate the skill by pressing LB/L1/Q button. 
- Combos make your score higher. Try hitting more zombies with the same color at a time and get more combos. 
- Joey is invincible when shooting, 2 secs after shooting and 2 secs after getting hit.
- Some zombies have 2 lives which you can tell by the white dot next to the bat that hovers on top.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/5431475ea3e0cca7dfaba3f85283b54afc8b9582.png[/img]

[b]Final Wave (Boss stage)[/b]
As you enter the final wave, you will see the hit gauge on the top. 
Boss will get damage only when you hit the same color that shows on the top bar or use ‘Breaking a curse’ skill.​

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/202410161117047.png[/img]

The final wave has 3 boss phases. His hat changes in each phase and so does his power and his HP.
The boss takes more hits as you go through the phases and summons more zombies. 

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2024101611182326.png[/img]
​
[b][High score reward][/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2024101611314539.png[/img]

You can also get free Spooktacular Tickets just for participating in the event.​

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2024101611403735.jpg[/img]

Want more rewards? We have the Weekly Zombie Mode Rank Event!

[b]2. Zombie Mode Ranking Event:[/b]

Eliminate as many zombies as you can and rise up this leaderboard! 

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2024101611435697.jpg[/img]

[b]Note:[b] Weekly rankings reset every Monday at 00:00 PDT​

*Where to use Spooktacular Tickets:

1. Check the obtained Spooktacular Tickets from the Message Box
- The obtained Ticket will go to the User Inventory

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2024101611465916.png[/img]

2. Use the obtained Ticket to exchange the following:
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2024101611482790.png[/img]

- Endless Nightmare Random Box
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2024101612441771.gif[/img]

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/202410161246407.gif[/img]

notes.title: DJ Bagman Streaming Challenge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/6794ba0e27af28de8851c8ebae59fc9b8abe1a1e.jpg[/img]

Experience 3on3 FreeStyle’s new legend DJ Bagman and upload your video via YouTube to win the Challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/b279d2d1e2983e7e757453f3d145d2b6cb0cc123.png[/img]

[b][How To Participate][/b]

-Make a video about DJ Bagman under following category:
[list]
[*] DJ Bagman’s Skill
[*] DJ Bagman Guide
[*] DJ Bagman Highlight
[/list]
- Upload your video via YouTube with #3on3FreeStyle.
- Clearly show your platform and PSN/Gamertag/Steam ID in your post.
- Submission Period: 8/21 – 9/3 23:59 PDT.
- Reward Distribution: 9/11 maintenance.

[b][Reward][/b]

1) Reward based on your view
 [list]
[*] 2,000: 200 Points
[*]  1,500: 100 Points
[*]  800: 50 Points
[*]  200: 20 Points
[/list]
2) If your video is selected for best video
 [list]
[*] 200 Points extra bonus!
[/list]
[b][Important Notes][/b]

- This challenge event reward is separate from our monthly streaming event. You can win reward from both event with same video.

- You must upload video within submission period.

- Upon submission and include event hashtags and you are aware of and agree with that your video might be linked in-game or part of our promotion video uploaded in YouTube.

- Only one video satisfying requirements with most view will be considered for reward.

- Video form is not limited. You can upload clip, livestreaming, or shorts.

- Best video is selected by 3on3 dev team. Both video quality and view will be considered.

- Your video contest MUST BE related with Giant G and exclusive for 3on3 FreeStyle. Showing other game content or brand will not be considered as candidate.

- Upon submission, you are agreeing with our Terms & Condition

[b][Terms & Condition][/b]

- You MUST meet Terms & Condition to be considered as a candidate.

- [b]No violation of copyright and age restriction content is allowed.[/b]

- [b]Video content MUST BE 3on3 FreeStyle EXCLUSIVE.[/b] No exposure of other games, anime, images, sounds, etc. is allowed.

- Negatively biased opinion, harassment, exposure of gun, racism, and any other [b]contents violating company's image is prohibited.[/b]

- By submitting your video,[b] you AGREE with our terms & condition of connecting your video to our game.[/b]

[b]- 3on3 Freestyle Team[/b]

notes.title: System Update: Patch Note ver. 1.1.133.0 (August 21st)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/1a3347ed268a2f4797ca449b199f45da502b49b4.jpg[/img]

Greetings, FS City!

The following are the updates for the end of this month, August 2024.

[b][System][/b]

[b]1. New Character Update; DJ Bagman[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ae1dbf329bb3970a08a3952b6de273d5f2ad73c3.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=DW2kSHOSkng;full][/previewyoutube]
Welcome to the Day Dreamer’s Court!
The mystic DJ Bagman is here to guide you into the butterfly dream!
Find out his dream-like play and fall into the endless dream!

[b][Illusion][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/6b3736fcbffe844eaec8acbc5b56415a8a70bf70.png[/img]
When performing a breakthrough dribble, the success rate of P4 shot skills increases by 5% for 5 seconds. DJ Bagman’s dribble has a special illusion effect which may put opponents into disarray! 
If you watch DJ Bagman’s dribble you feel like you are dreaming!

[b][Perfect Sense Of Rhythm][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c9f17325377c1deff4205333e814affd314fa67b.png[/img]
Breakthrough speed increases significantly, and DJ Bagman will not fall during the collision. Even though you try to stop DJ Bagman, he won’t fall!

[b][Intensive Skill][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/542ba49a659243350019b33f1d4c68eb03c7fc46.png[/img]
DJ Bagman comes out as Intensive Prestige unlocked! Check out his 3 strong intensive skills!

[b][Shot Fake Step][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/c9d8638f081432f7d19b2ac9a973256319e1ee22.png[/img]

[b][Pass During Drive-In][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/72f874ba95cee081b0c4194ba2f01ed2a280b033.png[/img]

[b][Double Clutch][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/5990121343198e0ee1393856b2eb5d3df880021d.png[/img]

[b]2. Ranked Mode Improvement[/b]

To improve better sportsmanship experience, new system is updated to all Ranked Modes!
Let’s check out how it works!

1) Now you cannot see the name of the opponents until revealing character selection.

2) You cannot break the line-up after the character is revealed. If one of the players is disconnected, the disconnected character will be replaced with Ai.

3) If one of your members is disconnected like described above, you can decide to give up the match early.

4) If you give up your current match, each team’s rank score will be :
[list]
[*] Lose : 50% rank score penalty compared to regular lose
[*] Win : Will not get any rank score for the match
[/list]
5) Based on your disconnection count, you will get a penalty for Ranked Mode. During penalty hour, you will not be able to enter Ranked Mode (Max 2 weeks). Your cumulated disconnection count will reset after the Rank season is over.

6) Extra -10 Rank Score penalty will be applied to the user who disconnected from the game. 
Please note that we may amend some rules based on the result of the current Ranked Mode result.

We hope everyone will respect other users and play fairly.

[i][b]- 3on3 Freestyle Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Creator Crew Program Season 4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/54e87c6920853ff4539d582211b721f2917c8c54.jpg[/img]

[b]Greet our Creator Crew Season 4![/b]

We are currently recruiting our dear creators to the Creator Crew Program!

Introducing Joycity’s game to newcomers and return users to get your rewards on hand!

Any content that you can create with game is your contribution!

If you would like to join our Creator Crew Program, please check below and sign ASAP!

[b][How To Join][/b]

[list]
[*] Go to Creator Crew webpage to become the member.
     [b][url=https://joycrew.joycity.com/en/46]LINK[/url][/b]
[*] Select [Apply to join Joycrew] button.
[*] Follow the guide and submit your information.
[/list]

Check our creator on every Wednesday!
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1292630/view/4255420398710845763?l=english]Link[/url][/b][i]– Chart will be updated on next Wednesday[/i]

[b][Get Your Reward][/b]

[b]1) Complete Basic Mission To Redeem $225 Reward![/b]
[list]
[*] Recruit at least 5 new follower and reach 100% progress of SNS missions!
[*] New follower must be user who joins 3on3 freestyle or other Joycity’s CCP participation game after the start of Creator Crew Program Season. They can be either new user or return user.

 - New User: first login date is after the start of CCP season.
 - Return User: Without login records of more than 90 days then returned after the start of CCP season.

[*] New follower must reach required account level to be eligible follower (for 3on3 FreeStyle, reach Lv.5).
[*] Detailed SNS missions will be announced later.[/list]

[b]2) Recruit At Least 15 New Follower For Extra Rewards![/b]
[list]
[*] You can receive 1 ~ 5% of the spending amount of your new followers!
[*] To receive spending of your follower, you must recruit at least 15 new followers
[*] Redeem rate:	
       *15 New Followers: 1%
       *30 New Followers: 3%
       *40 New Followers: 5%[/list]

[b][Submission period][/b]
[list]
[*] Submission Period: 7/1 ~ 9/30 07:59 PDT.
[*] Creator Selection Announcement: Every Tuesday during season.
[*] Feel free to submit your application during CCP season! Your application will be reviewed by CCP team weekly.[/list]

[b][Q&A][/b]

[b]1) Will my current followers be counted as my follower?[/b]
- No. Only new and return account who follow you via in-game will be considered as your new follower. Detailed guide regarding how to follow you will be announced later once we announced this season’s new creator.

[b]2) How can I get portion of my followers’ spending?[/b]

- There is some requirements to receive reward.
 [olist]
[*] You must have at least 15 new followers.
[*]  Your followers need to purchase DLC and do not refund it.
[*]  You must wait certain period so CCP team secure and confirm the purchase record of your followers.
[*]  If you decide cash reward, extra processing time will be required to process cash.
[/olist]
[b]3) What is SNS mission?[/b]

- Mission will be related with your YouTube and SNS activity. Detailed guideline will be announced by CCP team.

If you have any additional question, please contact send email to: joycrew@joycity.com

*[i]Do not send any CS regarding CCP to 3on3 team since we are not responsible of it.[/i]

THANK YOU FOR YOUR CONTINUED SUPPORT!

[b]- 3ON3 FREESTYLE TEAM[/b]

notes.title: System Update: Patch Note ver. 1.1.121.0 (March 27th)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/e57658f4eb8635f5b83eea1174564cbae476add1.jpg[/img]

Greetings, FS City!

The following are the updates for March 2024.

[b]1. Food Buff System Removal[/b]

As we stated before, the Food Buff system is removed to be revised for better benefit.
You cannot cook any more food from now on but you can still consume your remaining food until final removal.
Any unconsumed food will be removed and compensated with coins when final removal occurs.
We advise you to consume all remaining food before the next update.

[b]2. Newbie Half-Price Store[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/0b1045a051874c8959ed7804f79d452480b892f3.png[/img]

Here is how it works!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3617eb8c859af8d6068bd4ad6ae0626d2b9db4d8.png[/img]
- Mystery shop is available to any new comer joins after 3/27 maintenance
- Mystery shop will be available for 2 weeks since your first login
- You can purchase selective outfit, point character, celebration, and pet with discounted price

[b]3. 3on3 Jukebox Update[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/fc5e3a42a44071d7fd18c83f00494f1ad67727b0.png[/img]
Enjoy dynamic street music with Jukebox!
Customize your playlist and listen to your favorite music!

- Check the music you would like to play from the playlist.
- We have 2 play modes to enjoy music
---> Normal Mode: The playlist will run in order
---> Shuffle Mode: Random music in your playlist will be played.
- You can listen to your customized music anywhere except during the match!

We look forward to your continued support.

notes.title: Ability Card Issue Fix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/ae362a67d7afde75cad533d6820af92ea3be9874.png[/img]

Dear Ballers.

We were able to identify an anomaly affecting the intended functionality and presentation of the Ability Cards’ stat value. As of the maintenance on 3/20 PDT, this issue has been fixed.

Once the issue was identified, we immediately started verifying all the underlying data to ensure that all Ability Cards work as intended. After a thorough system review, we have confirmed and verified that most of the card data was correct and working as intended. 
However, a few minor fixes will be applied to some other cards as needed. 

Please read on for detailed information on the applied fixes.

[b]1. Ability Card Stat Value Range Discrepancy[/b]
- After the patch, all Ability Cards can now be obtained with the correct stat value range.
- If there were cards in your inventory with an incorrect stat value range prior to the patch, they have been adjusted to reflect the MAX value of the correct stat value range.
- If the affected and corrected Card’s stat value is lower after the patch, we’ve provided compensation by distributing a same-grade card pack of character per each Card corrected in this way.

- [b]Eligible/Affected Card List:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/3f2f6fbb437937535203cd901f16724f7d1f98b4.png[/img]

[b]2. Ability Card Slot Discrepancy[/b]
- All affected Ability Cards can now be pulled with the correct slot type applied
- Previously pulled Cards that displayed the incorrect Slot type currently in your inventory are now corrected to display the correct Slot type
- For each affected Card on the account, we’ve provided compensation by distributing 1 Mika’s Guaranteed Platinum Card Pack per each Card corrected.

-[b] Eligible/Affected Card List:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/1715dbca3ec919d89c95d94facca9a64acc96648.png[/img]

[b]3. Some Cards Aren’t Being Pulled from the Respective Character Card Pack[/b]
- The issue causing certain Cards from being able to be pulled from respective Character’s Card Packs has been fixed.

- [b]Affected Card List:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/98cec79d3ccccab8a58f06e0382b48757e5b76a1.png[/img]

We would like to sincerely apologize for the trouble this situation has caused. 
As a heartfelt expression of our sympathies, everyone in the game will receive x10 Random Platinum Card Packs. You can receive the reward upon login to the game by 4/2 23:59 PDT. Please make sure to redeem these beforehand.

Sincerely,

[b]-3on3 FreeStyle Development Team[/b]

notes.title: 3on3 FreeStyle: Engine Upgrade to UE5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a3e086e4229e5f77ae479f5a1887f36f026132fa.jpg[/img]

Dear Ballers,

We are excited to announce that we will be upgrading the engine of 3on3 FreeStyle from UE4 to UE5.
This decision was made to provide our players with the best possible gaming experience by utilizing the latest technology available.

The upgrade to UE5 will bring the following improvements to the game:

▷ [b]Improved in-game frame rate[/b]
- The game will run smoother and more responsively, providing a better overall gaming experience.

▷ [b]Enhanced graphics quality[/b]
- The game's graphics will be more visually appealing, with improved textures.

We are confident that the upgrade to UE5 will be a positive change for 3on3 FreeStyle and will allow us to continue to provide our players with the best possible game.

We would like to thank you all for your continued support of 3on3 FreeStyle.
We are committed to providing you with the best possible gaming experience, and we believe that the upgrade to UE5 is a step in the right direction.

Sincerely,
[i][b]3on3 FreeStyle DEV Team[/b][/i]

Greetings, FS City!

The long waited fair play system is here! Macro Prevention system is added to fair play system to encourage better sportsmanship!
Let’s check how it works!

- If your behavior is considered as macro, CAPTCHA will show up during game
- You have to input CAPTCHA correctly within time period
- If you fail to input CAPTCHA correctly 3 times or over the time period, you will be kicked from the game

notes.title: Creator Crew System
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/52f168a5ea84edd8fdc98b7c9a01cce0d0862ae8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8825687725495538964be8fa2ad533e265fa0d03.png[/img]

Welcome to JoyCity’s Creator Crew System!
We are currently recruiting our dear creators to the Creator Crew Program!
Introducing JoyCity’s game to newcomers and get your rewards on hand!
Any content that you can create with game is your contribution!
If you would like to join our Creator Crew Program, please check below and sign ASAP!

[previewyoutube=drhK9VE9we0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][How To Join][/b]
- Go to Creator Crew webpage to become the member! [[url=https://joycrew.joycity.com/en/29][b]LINK[/b][/url]]
- Select [Apply to join Joycrew] button
- Follow the guide and submit your information

[b][Get Your Reward][/b]
1) Complete Basic Mission To Redeem $225 Reward!
- Recruit at least 5 new follower and reach 100% progress of SNS missions!
- New follower must be user who joins 3on3 freestyle or other JoyCity’s CCP participation game after the start of Creator Crew Program Season
- New follower must reach required account level to be eligible follower (for 3on3 FreeStyle, reach Lv.5)
- Detailed SNS missions will be announced later
2) Recruit At Least 15 New Follower For Extra Rewards!
- You can receive 1 ~ 5% of the spending amount of your new followers!
- To receive spending of your follower, you must recruit at least 15 new followers
- Redeem rate:
	*15 New Followers : 1%
	*30 New Followers : 3%
	*40 New Followers : 5%

[b][Submission period][/b]
-Submission Period : 1/5 03:00 ~ 1/28 06:59 PST
-Creator Selection Announcement : 2/1
-No entry will be allowed after submission period
-After submission period, CCP team will review your application

[b][Q&A][/b]
1. Will my current followers be counted as my follower?
- No. Only new account created after certain period and follow you via in-game will be considered as your new follower. Detailed guide regarding how to follow you will be announced later once the season starts.
2. How can I get portion of my followers’ spending?
- There is some requirements to receive reward.

1) You must have at least 15 new followers.
2) Your followers need to purchase DLC and do not refund it.
3) You must wait certain period so CCP team secure and confirm the purchase record of your followers.
4) If you decide cash reward, extra processing time will be required to process cash.

3. What is SNS mission?
- Mission will be related with your YouTube and SNS activity. Detailed guideline will be announced by CCP team.

If you have any additional question, please contact send email to : joycrew@joycity.com

Thank you for your continued support!

- 3on3 FreeStyle Team

notes.title: New Character Update; Genesa
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a9e4ac1fcd718ee694836d62197233ba9e403aba.jpg[/img]

Greetings, FS City
The followings are the updates for the end of this month.

[b][System][/b]
[b]1. New Character Update; Genesa[/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023122005553664.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=NY0DC32SQOM;full][/previewyoutube]

The android walks back in time! Genesa is ready for order!
Genesa can change her mode to adapt to different situations.
Meet Genesa and find out how technologized she is!

[b][Dash Intercept][/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023122006015732.png[/img]

Momentarily dash to intercept the pass. Dive to the ball and intercept the pass quickly!

[b][Reverse Dunk][/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023122006024223.png[/img]

Go over to the opposite side of the goal and dunk. Utilize Genesa’s power protocol to trick the opponent and ring the rim!

[b][Mode Control][/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023122006032651.png[/img]

Genesa starts the game in Flash Mode (Steal +40) and can change to Dynamic mode (Field Block +40 & Steal -40) through Mode Control characteristics. She can change her mode 6 times in a single game. With Mode Control passive, Genesa can switch her ability to react to different situations.

Genesa's default's mode is Flash Mode. You can see enhanced Genesa's ability in Character page.

[b][Mode Reinforce][/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023122006040377.png[/img]

When Genesa is in Flash Mode, her 3-point-shot ability and movement speed ability additionally increase by 40. When she is in Dynamic Mode, her mid-range shot ability and long-distance dunk ability additionally increase by 40. Get extra ability bonus with Mode Reinforce passive!

[b][Intensive Skill][/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/202312200604580.png[/img]

Genesa comes out as Intensive Prestige unlocked! Check out her 3 strong intensive skills!

[b][Layup Pass][/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023122006054484.png[/img]

[b][Shadow Steal][/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023122006061552.png[/img]

[b][Cut In][/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023122006063661.png[/img]

[b]2. P7 Upgrade Unlock[/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023122006072645.png[/img]

The hidden potential of your legend is finally released!
Meet P7 update and how this majestic upgrade will enhance your character!

[b]1) How to upgrade character to P7[/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023122006080569.png[/img]

- Your character must be upgraded up to P6 and eligible for P7
- You need 2 position intensive manuals, 20 position manuals, and 16 advanced manuals

[b]2) What is the benefit of P7?[/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023122006084257.png[/img]

- You will unlock potential ability. For each level up, you will get potential point to upgrade the potential ability
- You will get extra intensive stat point for each level up

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023122006093095.png[/img]

- Limit of applicable intensive stat is extended from 10 to 15. You need to consume additional 2 intensive stat points if you want to add more than 10 stats

[b]3) What is Potential Ability?[/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023122006103830.png[/img]

- Potential ability grants you extended ability to P7 character
- You have 3 potential ability tree to determine character’s specialization. You can upgrade all trees as you wish.
- Each branch gives extra stat bonus or skill bonus
- To upgrade next branch, you must unlock previous branch
- Some branches are bonded as group. You can only select one branch in the group
- To find the potential ability, go to [Character] – [Attributes] – [Potential Ability]

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023122006115396.png[/img]

- To upgrade potential ability, you need position potential bead and potential point

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023122006131615.png[/img]

- You can purchase the bead with coin from shop
- Potential point can be acquired by level up P7 character
- If you want to reset potential ability, you can purchase potential reset ticket from the shop. When you reset potential ability, all consumed materials and potential points will be refunded

- [i][b]3on3 FreeStyle Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: 3on3 My Design Contest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/8d5b10db21dfa75380287e2d5657eeba6a643d91.png[/img]

Greetings FS City Ballers!

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023121307184975.png[/img]

[b]Event Period:[/b] 12/13 ~ 12/31 23:59 (PST)

Be the best designer of 3on3 FreeStyle!
3on3 My Design Contest is open now!
Let’s check out how to become the best designer of 3on3 FreeStyle

[b][How To Participate][/b]

[b]1) Basic Guideline[/b]
- We accept design for two category: Outfit & Pet
- You can submit drawing or photo. Photo is only accepted for outfit category
- Please upload your work via Twitter or Facebook with following information:
• Your Platform & In-Game Name
• Your Work
• Please include 2 event hashtags : #3on3FreeStyle & #3on3MyDesign
• If you upload drawing, please include at least 2 images of your work process or video of your work process
• If you have more than 4 images, please keep it as one thread
- You can submit multiple works, but only one submission will be selected
- No violation of copyright, age rating, legal rights, and company’s image

[b]2) I Want To Draw My Design[/b]
- You can participate Outfit & Pet category
- You must provide at least one front design for Outfit or Pet
- You may use our basic model to draw on: [[url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rHbWVIzA7xVIrWzo5TqXh3k_pTE3kQws][b]DOWNLOAD[/b][/url]]

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023121307225292.png[/img]

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023121307230652.png[/img]

- You can submit outfit with model or just outfit:

[b]*Submit with model[/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023121307240227.png[/img]

[b]*Submit just outfit[/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023121307244198.png[/img]

- You must provide at least 2 images of your work process or video:

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023121307253375.png[/img]

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023121307254497.png[/img]

- AI generated art will not be accepted
- We advise you to draw at least 1000 x 1000 pixels for drawing. If your image is too small, you may have disadvantage during review process

[b]2) I Want To Show My Style with Photo[/b]
- You can participate Outfit category
- Wear and style outfit that you would like to see in 3on3 FreeStyle
- You must provide at least front image of person, showing at least top and bottom
- You do not need to show your face for photo
- You must hold paper with your signed name to identify that it’s your photo:

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023121307281196.jpg[/img]

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023121307282532.jpg[/img]

- You are aware of and agree with that random audience will show your photo
- Any unauthorized use of photo of other will not be allowed

[b][Event Schedule][/b]
- Submission Period : 12/13 – 12/31 23:59 PST
- Internal Review : 1/1 – 1/2 23:59 PST
- Top 5 Designer Selection : 1/3 
- Random Draw Reward : 1/3
- Popularity Vote : 1/3 – 1/9 23:59 PST
- Winner Announcement : 1/10 
- Reward Distribution : 1/17
- Event Process : Submission -> Internal Review -> Select 5 Works -> Popularity Vote -> Vote Count + Internal Review -> Winner Selected

[b][Event Reward][/b]
- Winner : 5,000 Points + Platinum-Grade Best Designer Crown + Platinum-Grade Best Designer Nametag + Your Designed Theme or Pet Once Updated
- 2nd – 3rd : 2,000 Points + Gold-Grade Best Designer Crown + Gold-Grade Best Designer Nametag
- 4th – 5th : 800 Points + Silver-Grade Best Designer Crown + Silver-Grade Best Designer Crown
- Random Draw : 100 Points (5 People)
- Please note that getting most vote for popularity vote will not guarantee your winning. Internal review of 3on3 art team will decide the winner. 2nd – 5th reward is determined by vote count.

[b][Q&A][/b]

[b]1) Can I submit multiple works?[/b]
- [i]Yes, you can submit multiple works but only one work will be considered. You cannot received duplicate reward.[/i]

[b]2) Will you select winner for Outfit and Pet? In other words, will we have 2 winner for this event?[/b]
- [i]No, we only select one winner regardless of category.[/i]

[b]3) If I get most vote during popularity vote, will I be the winner?[/b]
- [i]No, 3on3 art team will review final candidates for winner. Vote count may affect the decision but does not guarantee the selection.[/i]

[b]4) Will JOYCITY gets the copyright of all submitted work?[/b]
- [i]No, only winner’s design. If you do not win first prize, we will not get any license for your design.[/i]

[b][Terms & Condition][/b]
- You must submit your work within submission period. Any submission submitted AFTER event period will be disregarded
- You must provide all designated information and include event hashtags to be considered as candidate
- You must upload your work to declared SNS (Twitter & Facebook). Any submission uploaded on other platform will not be considered
- No violation of copyright, age rating, legal rights, and company’s image
- If any legal issue occurs regarding submission, all responsibilities are on contributor’s side
- Only one submission will be selected for one candidate. If we find duplicate winner, only one work will be selected and others will be disregarded
- Getting most vote does not guarantee your winning of contest. Vote count and internal review of 3on3 art team will select the winner
- 2nd to 5th winner will be determined based on your vote count
- We may not select the winner or make winner’s design if there is no appropriate design
- Winner’s design may be renewed to match with 3on3 Freestyle’s design
- All reward and reward distribution date are subject to change without notice
- Copyright of winner’s design will be bound to JOYCITY and 3on3 FreeStyle team and all participants are aware of and agree with this condition
- Winner’s design is expected to be produced by June, 2024. This may change without notice
- We may produce winner’s design with renewed design or color in future
- We may ask you for the original file (PSD) of work. Refuse to provide such file may cause disqualification
- Terms & Condition may change without notice
- Upon submission, you agree with our terms & condition

Thank you for your continued support.

- [i][b]3on3 FreeStyle Team[/b][/i]

[b][Crossover][/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023112906461448.png[/img]

Change the direction of your drive to shake off the defender. Utilize the Crossover and trick the opponent to create various chances!

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023112906480036.png[/img]

Pass to a no-mark ally, avoiding the intercept. Depending on the pass stat, the intercept probability is further reduced.
You can pass that cannot be intercepted to distant allies.

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023112906483880.png[/img]

Dive toward the opponent and steal the ball. Shot success rate will be decreased for a short time on success.

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023112906493810.png[/img]

Feel lively street basketball matches with improved in-game motion and effect!
Feel the thrill, excitement, and cheer of spectators!
Let’s check out the change now!

- When you enter the court, new camera animation is added to show various aspects of the court which you cannot easily see during the match
- When you success Dunk or Block, the camera will shake! Feel the thrilling moment!
- When you success Shooting Touch, effect is added to let you know that you hit the perfect timing.
- When you success Pass or Rebound, effect is added that you successfully catch the ball.
- In certain situation, cheers of the crowd is added to enhance the lively moment.

[b]2) In-Game Animation Option[/b]

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023112906563222.png[/img]

New cumulative payment event system is updated!
Get up to 300% payback bonus for your payment!
Let’s check how you can receive this fabulous reward!

[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023112907001455.png[/img]

- Go to [Event] – [Cumulative Payment Event] to check your payment score
- You will get 10 score for $1 payment of any DLC purchase
- Upon hitting certain payment score, payback reward will be sent to your message box
- Cumulative payment bonus will reset after certain period

- Shooting success rate will decrease exponentially when a shot is made near half court line.

Thank you for your continued support.

[i][b]- 3on3 FreeStyle Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: System Update: New Intensive Character; Cindy
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017532/a13cd3f7ca2cf56a816d6b413e67030a5e8aba6e.png[/img]

Greetings, FS City
The followings are the updates for July

[b][System][/b]

[b]1. New Intensive Character; Cindy[/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023102505585769.png[/img]

Let’s Rock’n Roll! Cindy shows to her inner spirit with Intensive Update!
Let’s check out her emotic movement and new Intensive skills!

[b][Quick Jumper][/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/202310250600454.png[/img]

Perform a quick Jump Shot right after you receive a Pass. Utilize Cindy’s passive skills and aim the score!

[b][Blind Defense][/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023102506012989.png[/img]

Significantly reduces shoot success rate. Do you think Cindy is only good at passing? No ways! She can decrease your shot success rate and help teammates!

[b][Over Pass Intercept][/b]
[img]http://webservice-cf.joycityglobal.com/3on3/board/2023102506020148.png[/img]

Intercept an Over Pass. How you think to do the overpass in front of Cindy? She just simply jumps over and intercept your over pass!

[b]2. [Steam] In-Game Chat Improvement[/b]
In-game chat system has been improved to provide more enjoyable chat environment.

Let’s check out the change!

[b]1) Chatting Channel Change[/b]
- To change your chatting channel, click the UI button
- Your default chatting channel is changed to ‘Team-Channel’
- In 1vs1 mode, ‘All-Channel’ is default channel

[b]2) Mute Function[/b]
- You can now mute certain channel’s chat via Chat Option
- You can mute all chat or team chat. If you mute all chat, you can only see your teammate’s chat
- To change your chat option, mark the chat visibility right on the input UI
- If you block a user, you will not see blocked user’s chat regardless of your chat option

Thank you for your continued support.

[i][b]- 3on3 FreeStyle Team[/b][/i]

notes.content:

Greetings FS City Ballers,
The following are the updates for the end of this month.
